question: 假设水费单价上调5%，用水最多多少度才能将水费控制在10000元以内（取整数）？

steps.description: Locate the total water fee amount displayed in the record and read its value
Find the water usage amount (in degrees/cubic meters) shown in the record and read its value
Divide the total water fee by the water usage to calculate the original unit price
Extract the price increase percentage mentioned in the question text
Apply the price increase percentage to the original unit price to get the adjusted price
Identify the water fee budget limit specified in the question
Divide the budget limit by the adjusted unit price to find maximum degrees
Round down to the nearest integer to satisfy the constraint
